operations.body: Entry 1204: complementary occurrence labels act identically on the grade-zero infinity branch, but qhat_A-qhat_Ac=2 rho X_A on E_T=0. The 240 differences split into 200 type 1|4 and 40 type 2|3 generators, i.e. 40+8 regular C5 orbits. Thus occurrence is filtered normal information rather than extra grade-zero geometry.
